description: 광주교통공사_역사별 환승 데이터 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 광주교통공사. 특히 버스·지하철 간 환승 시간과 위치가 함께 기록되어 있어, 복합 환승센터 설계, 환승 안내 시스템 구축, 혼잡도 분산 계획 등에도 중요한 기초 자료로 쓰입니다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
